name: Saffron
desc: Saffron is a Khan NPC. They are one of the three disciples required for obtaining Oathless for the first time.
additional_info:
-   Saffron wears the Verdant Sniper outfit.
-   If you already have an Oath, or not on the Oathless quest line, he will only say "..."
-   His Khan aspect variant is Albino.
-   He is named after a city in the Kanto region from the _Pokémon_ franchise. Namely, _Saffron City_.
    -   This follows the same pattern with the other Oathless npcs. For more information you can look at [Cerulean](entity:cerulean), [Celadon](entity:celadon), and [Viridian](entity:viridian).
-   Saffron can mean the shade of the color yellow, or a spice. The spice being the color deep red.
-   Weirdly enough, Saffron has a unique dialogue compared to the other disciples, being "Those eyes... You wish to" and continue. While the others, [Viridian](entity:viridian) and [Celadon](entity:celadon), saying "Those eyes.. you wish to" and continue.
    -   The only difference these have is that, Saffron has 3 dots and a capitalized Y in "You", while the others have 2 dots and a lower case Y in "you."
